title: Dual constraints with ALMA: new [O III] 88-μm and dust-continuum observations reveal the ISM conditions of luminous LBGs at z   7
question: What are the ISM conditions (ionisation state, metallicity, dust temperature, and dust mass) of five luminous Lyman-break galaxies at z ~ 7 revealed by ALMA observations of [O III] 88 μm, [C II] 158 μm, [N II] 205 μm, and dust continuum?

data.sensitivity: 45.0 to 272 μJy/beam per 40 MHz channel ([C II]); 429 to 1015 μJy/beam per 70 MHz channel ([O III]); 166 μJy/beam per 30 MHz channel ([N II])

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA line and continuum visibilities
recipe.method: Calibrate visibilities with the CASA pipeline, subtract continuum in the uv plane with uvcontsub where continuum is detected, and image line cubes and mfs continuum maps with tclean using natural/Briggs weighting and uv tapers.
key_parameters: tclean threshold set to 3x theoretical sensitivity
0.6'' uv taper for total [O III] and [C II] line fluxes; |v| > 1000 km/s for mfs continuum
assumptions: Antenna efficiency factor η ~ 0.7 (A_eff ~ 80 m^2 for 12-m dishes)

recipe.goal: Measure dust continuum fluxes, source sizes, and upper limits
recipe.method: Measure continuum flux densities and deconvolved source sizes with 2D Gaussian fits (CASA imfit) or matched apertures on beam-matched tapered maps; place 3σ upper limits from RMS noise in beam/source-sized apertures.
key_parameters: 3σ upper limits; 10% systematic flux error (Bands 5, 6) and 20% (Band 8)
assumptions: Cosmological parameters Ω_m = 0.3, Ω_Λ = 0.7, H_0 = 70 km s^-1 Mpc^-1

recipe.goal: Measure emission line fluxes, luminosities, and upper limits for [O III], [C II], and [N II]
recipe.method: Create moment-zero maps over the line FWHM; extract SNR-weighted spectra from contiguous >=2σ spaxels in 0.6'' tapered cubes and integrate over line channels for [O III] and [C II]; compute 3σ upper limit for [N II] over a single beam and 2x FWHM channel range.
key_parameters: 0.6'' tapered cubes for [O III] and [C II]; contiguous spaxels >= 2σ; untapered natural cube for [N II]
assumptions: COS-2987030247 is unresolved in [N II] 205 μm

recipe.goal: Fit far-infrared dust SEDs and derive dust masses, temperatures, IR luminosities, SFRs, and dust yields
recipe.method: Fit CMB-corrected modified blackbody (greybody) models to multi-band continuum detections and upper limits using mercurius (pymultinest/MultiNest), then compute L_IR, L_FIR, SFR_IR, and AGB/SN dust yields.
key_parameters: β_IR = 1.5 fixed; T_dust = 50 K fixed for sources with only upper limits; self-consistent opacity model (plus optically thin and fixed λ_0 = 200 μm variants)
assumptions: κ_ν,ref = 8.94 cm^2 g^-1 at λ_ref = 158 μm; clustering factor C = 1; Chabrier (2003) IMF for dust yields; Kennicutt & Evans (2012) SFR conversions

recipe.goal: Estimate molecular gas masses and gas-to-dust / gas-to-stellar mass ratios
recipe.method: Convert [C II] 158 μm luminosities to molecular gas masses using the Zanella et al. (2018) linear calibration and divide by M_dust and M_*.
assumptions: Zanella et al. (2018) calibration holds at z ~ 7

recipe.goal: Compare observed emission line ratios and strengths with Cloudy photoionisation + PDR models
recipe.method: Run 1D plane-parallel Cloudy v17.02 models with BPASS v2.1 binary stellar spectra across grids of ionisation parameter, metallicity, density, α/Fe enhancement, and stopping criteria, and compare to observed L_[C II]/L_[N II], L_[O III]/L_[C II], L_[O III]/SFR, and EW([O III] + Hβ).
key_parameters: log10 U from -4 to -0.5 (step 0.5); log10(n_H [cm^-3]) from 0.5 to 3 (fiducial 10^2 cm^-3); Z_*/Z_sun in {0.005, 0.05, 0.2, 1}; X_α/Fe,neb = 1 and 4; stopping criterion A_V = 10 mag (or H_2 fraction 10^-6)
assumptions: 1D plane-parallel ionisation-bounded nebula; Salpeter IMF (1-100 M_sun) with interacting binaries; Orion-like graphite and silicate grains; turbulent velocity 1.5 km/s; CMB at z = 7

recipe.goal: Perform spatially resolved comparison of [O III], [C II], dust continuum, and HST rest-frame UV
recipe.method: Combine and astrometrically align HST images to Gaia, convolve HST UV to match ALMA continuum PSF using a Richardson-Lucy kernel, regrid beam-matched [O III] and [C II] maps to a common mesh to create ratio maps, and extract spatially resolved [O III]/[C II] and L_IR/L_UV in apertures.
key_parameters: AstroDrizzle final_pixfrac = 0.8, pixel size = 0.065''; ratio maps where both lines >= 3σ; aperture circles with radius 1.5x mean circularised beam; 2σ threshold for resolved region measurements

evidence.quote: The lower limit on the [C ii] 158 μm to [N ii] 205 μm ratio is 𝐿[C ii]/𝐿[N ii] > 4.8 (3𝜎).

score_reason: All 10 ALMA project codes, HST dataset DOIs, CASA versions, weighting/taper schemes, flux extraction methodology, and the custom SED fitting code (mercurius on GitHub) are explicitly provided, with only minor tclean imaging parameters (cell size, imsize) and exact channel integration bounds left unstated.
rediscovery_reason: All raw ALMA and HST data are public, the custom Bayesian SED fitting tool (mercurius) is open-source, the calibration and imaging recipe is well-specified, and the main results are concrete numeric tables of line fluxes, continuum fluxes, dust temperatures/masses, and gas masses.
